KEYS REQUIRED BEFORE PROCEEDING
You should have already collected your keys from 23 Lonsdale Street, Braddon before going to the property. If you don't have your keys yet, tap here for key collection instructions or call us on 0493 173 122.

Check-In Instructions

Choose your check-in route below.

Step 1
Your Keys
Your keyring has two items — a black fob (swipe card for all readers) and a standard door key (front door of the apartment).
Step 2
Head to 1 Gordon Street
Head to 1 Gordon Street, City. Look for the Metropolitan Gordon East building with the "M" logo on the front entrance.
Step 3
Scan Your Fob to Enter
Scan your black fob on the reader at the front entrance to unlock the door and enter the building.
Step 4
Take the Lift to Mezzanine
Take the lift to the Mezzanine (M) level. Scan your fob on the reader inside the lift and press M.
Step 5
Find Apartment 6
Turn left out of the elevator — Apartment 6 is on the left hand side. Use your door key to enter. Enjoy your stay!
Step 1
Your Keys
Your keyring has two items — a black fob (swipe card for all readers) and a standard door key (front door of the apartment).
Step 2
Head to 1 Gordon Street
Head to 1 Gordon Street, City. The carpark entry is located off Gordon Street — look for the entry point as shown.
Step 3
Enter via The Mews
Enter via The Mews and head toward the carpark entry.
Step 4
Boom Gate Entry
The boom gate will open automatically. Directly after the boom gate, take a sharp right hand turn into the carpark tunnel.
Step 5
Scan Fob on the Reader on the Right
At the end of the tunnel, scan your black fob on the reader on the right to open the gate, then turn right.
Step 6
Proceed to the End, Turn Right at Bike Racks
Once through the gate, proceed all the way to the end and turn right at the bike racks.
Step 7
Down the Ramp, Turn Right
You will see a ramp going down then back up. Go down the ramp and turn right before the up ramp.
Step 8
Continue Straight, Then Turn Left
Continue straight all the way to the end, then turn left.
Step 9
Follow the Road Around to Space GE006
After taking the left turn, follow the road around in an almost U-turn shape. Your car space GE006 is located at the end, before the ramp.
Step 10
Park in Space GE006
Continue along and park in space GE006 — located before the ramp.
Step 11
Take the Elevator to Mezzanine
Take the elevator adjacent to your car space. Scan your black fob on the reader and press M for Mezzanine.
Step 12
Press M for Mezzanine
Inside the lift, scan your black fob on the reader then press M for Mezzanine.
Step 13
Find Apartment 6
Turn left out of the elevator — Apartment 6 is on the left hand side. Use your door key to enter. Enjoy your stay!
